hooks.text: 带领濒临灭绝的哥布林重建巢穴，让族群重新繁盛
hooks.excerpt: Goblins have been hunted to extinction by cruel adventurers. Embark on a heartwarming adventure to rebuild their lair and help them thrive in this award-winning turn-based RPG where every decision counts.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 混搭职业、能力与遗传特质，培育专属哥布林小队
hooks.excerpt: Craft the perfect goblin party by mixing classes, abilities, and genetics.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用站位决定行动顺序的创新回合制战斗
hooks.excerpt: Experience an innovative turn-based combat system, where the order of actions is determined by the strategic positioning of combatants.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
